zh: 香港立法會通過修訂銀行條例
簡化本地銀行體系至雙層制
政府指規則將更接近其他金融中心
work.en: The Legislative Council has passed a bill amending Hong Kong's Banking Ordinance to simplify the local banking system into two tiers. According to the government, the amendment covers five areas, including bank holding companies, to bring local rules closer to those of other major international financial centres.
work.title: Hong Kong Simplifies Its Banking System to Two Tiers

zh: 證監會與金融市場標準局簽署協議
將就固定收益及外匯標準發表意見
諮詢涵蓋全球債券與外匯市場規範
work.en: Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) has signed a Consultation Agreement with the Financial Markets Standards Board (FMSB). Under the agreement, the FMSB will seek the SFC's views on draft standards and guidance covering global fixed income and currency markets.
work.title: SFC to Weigh In on Industry Standards for Bond and FX Markets

zh: 研究指亞太兩成八客戶對主銀行不滿
近四分一客戶表示準備更換銀行
分析建議銀行縮減預期落差以留客
work.en: Research by Celent and Temenos shows that 28% of APAC banking customers are only slightly satisfied or not satisfied with their primary bank, with 23% slightly satisfied and 5% completely unsatisfied. The findings indicate that 1 in 4 APAC banking clients are ready to switch institutions.
work.title: 1 in 4 APAC Bank Customers Are Ready to Switch. Here’s How to Stop Them

zh: Ant與星展等完成自動代幣轉換試驗
於Whale協定自動轉換代幣化存款
支援代幣化存款與貨幣市場基金切換
work.en: Ant International has launched its Whale Orchestration Protocol to automatically switch between tokenized deposits and tokenized money market funds. Developed in collaboration with DBS Bank and Franklin Templeton under Singapore’s Project BLOOM, the partners have completed a pilot for the protocol.
work.title: Ant International, DBS, Franklin Templeton automate tokenized deposit to MMF switching

zh: 現代卡與摩根大通測試人工智能代理
AI代理自主完成跨境資金轉帳試驗
協作處理現金管理及外匯交易
work.en: Hyundai Card has completed a proof of concept with Kinexys by J.P. Morgan testing autonomous AI agents for cross-border payments. The trial demonstrated that interacting AI agents can independently manage cash, foreign exchange, and fund transfers.
work.title: Hyundai Card and J.P. Morgan Test AI Agents for Cross-Border Transfers

zh: 美聯儲會議紀錄顯示多數支持加息
官員認為通脹居高不下需繼續應對
幾乎所有與會者主張有必要進一步加息
work.en: Minutes from the US Federal Reserve's October meeting revealed that almost all participants judged further interest rate hikes would likely be necessary. Policymakers cited stubbornly high inflation as the main primary driver for maintaining a hawkish stance.
work.title: 'Most Fed policymakers think more rate hikes likely'

zh: 美元指數創逾一年半新高達103.97
美十年期國債息回落至5.04厘
日圓跌至159.66英鎊跌破1.31
work.en: The US dollar index rose for an eighth consecutive session to 103.97, hitting a new 1.5-year high. Meanwhile, the US 10-year Treasury yield dropped by about 3 basis points to 5.04%, with the Japanese yen trading around 159.66 against the dollar.
work.title: 美元指數再創逾1年半新高 美國10年期債息下試5厘

personal_hk.headline: 天文台：明日日間氣溫續降加上風寒效應 提醒市民注意保暖
personal_hk.body:
受強烈東北季候風及雲雨帶影響，本港氣溫顯著轉涼並有幾陣雨。
市區氣溫降至13至14度，新界部分地區及高地寒冷。
personal_hk.title: 天文台：明日日間氣溫續降加上風寒效應 提醒市民注意保暖

personal_hk.headline: 逾300人報案稱被兩寄賣店拖欠寄賣款項 涉款共4190萬元
personal_hk.body:
警方接獲超過300人報案，指銅鑼灣羅素街及中區夏愨道兩間寄賣店懷疑拖欠款項。
兩案分別涉款約3000萬及1190萬元，警方正跟進調查。
personal_hk.title: 逾300人報案稱被兩寄賣店拖欠寄賣款項 涉款共4190萬元

personal_hk.headline: 菲律賓進口蟹樣本被檢出鎘含量超出法例上限近兩倍
personal_hk.body:
食安中心在進口層面抽查發現一個菲律賓蟹樣本的鎘含量達百萬分之5.6，超標1.8倍。
受影響批次沒有流出市面，中心已知會進口商及菲律賓當局並進行跟進。
personal_hk.title: 菲律賓進口蟹樣本被檢出鎘含量超出法例上限近兩倍

personal_hk.headline: 競委會上訴得直 恆豐酒店經營者合謀定價罰款提高至95萬
personal_hk.body:
高等法院上訴庭裁定競委會上訴得直，指原判10.4萬元罰款未能反映違法嚴重性。
恆豐酒店經營者合謀定價罰款被提高至95萬元，並須支付競委會訟費。
personal_hk.title: 競委會上訴得直 恆豐酒店經營者合謀定價罰款提高至95萬

personal_hk.headline: 信置及鷹君財團近27億元投得市建局土瓜灣道/榮光街項目
personal_hk.body:
項目由信置及鷹君財團以26.88億元投得，折合每平方呎樓面地價約5072元。
地盤面積近5.9萬平方呎，中標價贴近市場預期下限。
personal_hk.title: 信置及鷹君財團近27億元投得市建局土瓜灣道/榮光街項目

personal_sg.headline: At 'historic' APEC meeting, Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong calls Shenzhen's transformation 'remarkable'
personal_sg.body:
Prime Minister Lawrence Wong attended the APEC Economic Leaders' Summit in Shenzhen after flying in from a summit in the Philippines.
He posted about the city's marked development and remarkable changes.
personal_sg.title: At 'historic' APEC meeting, Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong calls Shenzhen's transformation 'remarkable'

personal_sg.headline: Josephine Teo: Singapore believes technology only fulfils its purpose when it works for people
personal_sg.body:
Minister for Digital Development and Information Josephine Teo conducted an official working visit to the US.
Her trip included tech-related engagements in Washington, D.C. starting Nov 12.
personal_sg.title: Josephine Teo: Singapore believes technology only fulfils its purpose when it works for people

personal_sg.headline: ‘Plenty of avenues’: Shanmugam says Singaporeans can express views without street protests
personal_sg.body:
Senior Minister K Shanmugam addressed Singapore's strict permit-based approach to public protests in a CNA interview.
He emphasized that maintaining public order and stability remains the priority while alternative avenues for expression exist.
personal_sg.title: ‘Plenty of avenues’: Shanmugam says Singaporeans can express views without street protests

personal_sg.headline: SDP chief says political parties should not claim ownership of neighbourhoods after Yuhua encounter
personal_sg.body:
Singapore Democratic Party chief Chee Soon Juan recounted an encounter with PAP members at Yuhua Village Food Centre.
He stated on social media that political parties should not claim ownership over neighbourhoods.
personal_sg.title: SDP chief says political parties should not claim ownership of neighbourhoods after Yuhua encounter

personal_sg.headline: Workers’ Party believes in legislating benefits for workers experiencing AI-related retrenchment and anxieties
personal_sg.body:
Former NCMP Yee Jenn Jong represented the Workers' Party at an international political party conference in Seoul.
He advocated for legislating support benefits for workers facing AI-driven job disruptions.
personal_sg.title: Workers’ Party believes in legislating benefits for workers experiencing AI-related retrenchment and anxieties

juicy_hk.headline: 香港男子高等法院被判謀殺瑜伽女教練前女友罪成
juicy_hk.body: 32歲被告Alex Lo被控四年前於豪華酒店房間浴缸內謀殺前女友，高等法院七人陪審團一致裁定其謀殺罪名成立。
juicy_hk.title: Hong Kong man found guilty of murdering yoga instructor ex-girlfriend in luxury hotel room

juicy_hk.headline: 揭發學生程式造假舉報人反被控四項起底罪
juicy_hk.body: 一名女舉報人先前公開質疑中學生得獎App合法性引發網絡關注，如今被律政司正式控告四項未經同意披露個人資料的「起底」罪名。

juicy_hk.headline: 休班警偷拍女子裙底罪成 被判120小時社會服務令
juicy_hk.body: 警員何嘉俊休班期間偷拍女子裙底被裁定罪成，於沙田裁判法院被判處120小時社會服務令。
juicy_hk.title: Police officer convicted over upskirt photos sentenced to 120 hours of community service

juicy_hk.headline: 中大醫院致歉 醫生手術錯誤切除女患者雙側卵巢
juicy_hk.body: 香港中文大學醫院行政總裁鍾健禮召開記者會，就醫生在手術過程中錯誤切除一名女患者的卵巢向病人及家屬公開致歉。
juicy_hk.title: Hong Kong private hospital apologises after doctor mistakenly removed patient’s ovaries during operation

juicy_hk.headline: 行政長官座駕灣仔撞傷19歲女行人腳趾
juicy_hk.body: 特首辦證實行政長官專用座駕於灣仔碰撞一名19歲女子致其腳趾受傷，事發時特首李家超並不在車上。
juicy_hk.title: 19-year-old woman injured after being hit by Hong Kong chief executive’s official car in Wan Chai

juicy_hk.headline: 深圳APEC峰會期間 警方於上水及多區拘捕五人涉非法飛無人機
juicy_hk.body: 警方於亞太經合組織峰會期間展開行動，在粉嶺及多區拘捕五名年齡介乎27至65歲男子，涉嫌非法操作無人機航拍。
juicy_hk.title: Hong Kong police arrest five over illegal drone flights during Shenzhen APEC summit

juicy_hk.headline: 政府向立法會申請198億港元撥款 推動牛潭尾前期工程
juicy_hk.body: 發展局向立法會提交文件，申請撥款198億港元用於北部都會區牛潭尾項目的早期開發與基礎設施建設。
juicy_hk.title: Hong Kong gov’t seeks HK$19.8 billion from legislature to fund early Ngau Tam Mei development

juicy_sg.headline: Woman Arrested After Facial Recognition Catches 33 Alleged Shop Theft Incidents at Sheng Siong
juicy_sg.body: A 26-year-old woman was among 11 people charged in court for shoplifting after facial recognition cameras at Sheng Siong supermarket exposed her 33 repeated thefts. Other cases involved targeted thefts of cosmetics, alcohol, and groceries.
juicy_sg.title: 11 to be charged with shop theft; Woman caught by Sheng Siong facial recognition after 33 alleged thefts

juicy_sg.headline: Two Elderly Women Charged for Vandalising NParks Crow Traps
juicy_sg.body: Two senior citizens were charged in court after allegedly interfering with and vandalising crow traps set up by NParks in Yishun and Bukit Panjang. Their actions allowed trapped birds to escape and disrupted official bird control efforts.
juicy_sg.title: Elderly women accused of interfering with crow traps in Yishun and Bukit Panjang

juicy_sg.headline: MP Proposes Centralising Beverage Container Deposit Returns for F&B Sector
juicy_sg.body: Workers' Party MP Louis Chua suggested that centralising empty container collection would be more efficient for F&B operators under the upcoming Beverage Container Return Scheme. The national scheme refunds a 10-cent deposit when consumers return empty containers to reverse vending machines.
juicy_sg.title: Workers' Party MP Louis Chua says it may be more efficient for F&B operators to centralise BCRS collection

juicy_sg.headline: Singaporeans Debate Over-Emphasis on Workplace Productivity Over Leisure
juicy_sg.body: An online debate erupted among Singaporeans regarding whether recreational activities like cycling and pickleball are being treated with overly intense focus on self-improvement rather than pure fun. Netizens questioned whether society's constant push for productivity leaves enough room for simple enjoyment.
juicy_sg.title: ‘Where is the fun in life?’ Singaporeans debate society's focus on work and productivity
